Finding support in Singapore

Peer support: For a Singapore community resource, see the Lymphatics Association of Singapore.

Professional support: The NCCS emotional-support information describes counselling for NCCS patients and their caregivers on cancer-related concerns.

Peer support and professional counselling are different resources. Check current eligibility and arrangements directly with the organisation.

For the wider care journey, see supportive care for lymphedema.
